title: Page 6
content_zh:
天信集团乃台湾商界重量级集团，经营范围含括石化能源、百货零售、金融服务、海陆运输、通讯网路、社会公益……等领域，为国内老字号集团转往多角化经营成功的典范。
第三代掌门人掌信年届六十，现已交棒给第四代，他的三个儿子——
掌尚智、掌尚仁、掌尚勇。
国小毕业就陆续出国当小留生的三兄弟，在国外拿到企业管理博士后，陆续回国。
总裁一职由大儿子掌尚智接掌，年届三十的他成熟、稳重，肃穆神情常令人不寒而栗。
三年前拿到双博士学位，回国在父亲身边帮忙，不到半年的时间，已经顺利干掉老头……呃，不是，是帮父亲扛下肩头重担。一年前，父亲完全放心地把天信集团交给他，他誓言要带领天信集团再创高峰。
副总裁则由二十八岁的二儿子掌尚仁担任，外貌俊美的他，最擅长的是花言巧语和为富不仁的奸商手段。
而甫回国不到半年的三儿子掌尚勇，则是接下首席财务总监一职。
英气逼人的三兄弟，魅力无法挡，三年来，想考进天信集团的女性同胞，加总起来超过三万人，录取率屡创新低。据说，过去几十年报考的女性全部加总，尚不到一百人。
这是好现象。掌信和妻子夏水荷可乐歪了嘴，心里打着主意，想从女性员工里，挑出三个优秀的女生来当他们掌家的媳妇。
这个馊主意，早就被成为奸商……呃，聪明过人的三兄弟识破，三人联合起来，把老爸老妈送到国外去旅游半年，至少他们的耳根子可以清静半年。
现阶段，老大掌尚智一心想再创天信集团的事业高峰，哪有时间谈恋爱、娶老婆！
而老二掌尚仁满肚子的花言巧语，怎么可能只对一个女生说，不嫌太暴殄天物吗？老爸，您就别闹了吧！
老三掌尚勇没想太多，但是，被夜店的一堆辣美眉簇拥，感觉挺不错的，他可不想在夜店当大王时，被一个黄脸婆拉着耳朵，一路念回家。
所以，要他们结婚？别傻了，短期之内绝不可能！
第1章(1)
“巴瑞儿，开门！”
“再不开门，我就拿钥匙开喽！”
“你别再躲了，我知道你在里面！”
门外，轰隆隆的拍门声，吵得躺在床上补眠的巴瑞儿无法安睡，翻身下床，套了件衣服，披头散发的她，怒瞪着门板，就听到门外那个虎姑婆拿钥匙在开门，她先一步用力拉开门。

“一大早你在吵什么？不知道人家还在睡觉吗？”不满的眼神射向呆愣一秒钟的中年妇人。
“你……你在给我凶什么！”妇人回过神，拎着钥匙的手指着一脸浓浓睡意的巴瑞儿，恶声嚷着，“你还有脸睡！三个月房租没缴，还敢嚷得比我大声！”
“比你大声又怎样，不行喔！”谁规定没缴房租，说话就要比蚊子还小声？“我在这里住了四年，给你赚了四年的房租，现在我没工作，稍微欠你几个月房租，你就像夺命鬼一样，每天照三餐来敲门，是怎样？”
“反、反正你——”
“等我找到工作，就会付你房租，又不会落跑，你不用一天到晚都来催！”
“等你找到工作？要是你一整年都没找到工作，那你不就要欠我一年的房租？”
“如果真被你这张乌鸦嘴说中，那你今年就别想要房租了。”她没找到工作，她很乐是不是！“我要睡觉，你不要再来敲门了，否则我诅咒你下半年一整栋楼的房租都收不到。”
“你以为这样说我就怕了你？”眼明手快的房东，在她想关门之前，用中广的身材挡住门板。“瑞儿，我可是念在你在我这里住了四年，才让你拖这么久没赶你走，这样吧，不要说我不近人情，四年我就让你住满四个月，你已经欠我三个月的房租，我让你住到这个月底，时间一到，房租没交，你就自动搬走，但你还是欠我四个月的——”
“知道了！不用一直念。”
把卡在门缝的大肉丸推开，用力关上门，睡意全消，巴瑞儿呆愣坐在床沿。
现在是月初，离月底还有二十多天，可是……就算这几天顺利找到工作，月底她也没钱缴房租。
其实，她不是找不到工作，大学毕业后，她在一家广告公司担任平面设计师，做得还不错，只是，她厌倦了，真的倦了，很难想像才短短四年，她就得了职业倦怠症。
也许是因为去年母亲过世，让她深刻体会，人生不应该就只是这样……
也许……
总之，她对广告公司的工作，意兴阑珊，失去了热情。
明知道在现今高失业率的社会有份稳定的工作，该好好珍惜，可她也不知道自己哪根筋不对劲，丢了辞呈，潇洒走人，同事们错愕之余，不忘努力卡位，每个人都力争上游想坐上她的位子。
翻看银行存簿，她的存款少得可怜，只剩几千块钱，省一点的话，这些钱可以撑一个月的餐费，但却连缴一个月的房租都不够。
母亲得了乳癌，生前的医药费，由她们三姊妹共同支出，她花光所有积蓄，家里唯一的财产，那栋有她们三姊妹共同成长回忆的老房子也卖掉。
大姊已结婚生子，姊夫日前被公司裁员，家中经济陷入困境，她不能再添大姊的负担；二姊则是跟着美籍男友飞往美国，也不知道人究竟落脚何处……
巴瑞儿苦笑，就算二姊在台湾，她也帮不了她，乐天派的二姊向来是有多少花多少，从来没有所谓的闲钱。

她是有几个可以借到钱的好朋友，但，她不想让友谊中断在她借钱还房租这件事上。看来眼前只有这个办法了——
两眼直盯着放在床上的某周刊，封面那个帅到连天上星星都黯然失色的家伙，几百年前，曾欠她一笔小小的“爱心费”。
她是不知道他是否还记得，但她，一辈子都会记得，不是因为他欠她钱，而是……他是她第一个暗恋的对象，在国小时。
盯着封面上的人看，她莫名地羞红了脸。
国小六年级时，班导期许家境优渥的同学们在过着富裕的生活之余，能培养爱心及关怀社会的心，从六年级上学期第一天开始，希望他们每人每天都能捐出十元，投入班上的爱心箱，等学期未结束，再将爱心箱捐给社福单位。
她家小康，不在班导规定的每日一捐名单中，但她却每天都将买早餐的十块钱，“借”给他捐入爱心箱，因为那有钱的公子哥，身上只有千元大钞，没有十元硬币。
当初，偷偷暗恋他的她很慷慨的跟他说“不用还钱”，但她记得，他有和她说过“毕业前，我会把钱一次还清”。
但，有没有还？并没有。
所以，为了筹房租费，她不得不硬着头皮，向他索讨这笔“陈年爱心债”。
飞快的在日历纸上写下一段话，贴心的附上回邮信封，并写上她租用的邮政信箱地址。
看着封面上笑得令她脸红心跳的可恶家伙，不知道经过这么多年，他那张嘴是不是还“舌灿莲花”到令人想剪断他的舌头——
唉！都什么时候了，她管他是否变成花言巧语的滥情家伙，还是一句话也说不出的大哑巴，只要他愿意还钱救急，从此两人“互不相欠”。
周刊上斗大的标题写着——
天信集团代理总裁掌尚仁夜会正妹辣妹乳沟妹
content_en:
Tianxin Group is a heavyweight group in Taiwan's business community. Its business scope includes petrochemical energy, department store retail, financial services, land and sea transportation, communication networks, social welfare... and other fields. It is a successful example of domestic time-honored groups turning to diversified operations.
The third-generation head of the family, who is now sixty years old, has handed over the reins to the fourth generation, his three sons——
The palm promotes wisdom, the palm promotes benevolence, and the palm promotes courage.
The three brothers, who went abroad to study as primary school students after graduating from elementary school, received postdocs in business management abroad and returned to China one after another.
The position of CEO was taken over by the eldest son Zhang Shangzhi. He is mature and steady in his thirties, and his solemn expression is often chilling.
I got a double doctorate three years ago and returned to China to help my father. In less than half a year, I had successfully killed the old man... Well, no, I was helping my father carry the heavy burden on his shoulders. A year ago, his father handed Tianxin Group over to him with complete confidence, and he vowed to lead Tianxin Group to new heights.
The vice president is held by the 28-year-old second son Zhang Shangren. He is handsome in appearance and is best at smooth talk and ruthless businessmanship to get rich.
The third son, Zhang Shangyong, who had just returned to China less than half a year ago, took over the post of chief financial director.
The three heroic brothers are irresistibly charming. In the past three years, the total number of female compatriots who want to be admitted to Tianxin Group has exceeded 30,000, and the admission rate has hit new lows. It is said that the total number of women who have applied for the exam in the past few decades is less than 100.
This is a good sign. Zhang Xin and his wife Xia Shuihe Cola twisted their mouths and made up their mind to select three outstanding girls from among the female employees to be the wives of their boss.
This bad idea has long been seen through by the three brothers who became profiteers... well, they were extremely smart. The three of them joined forces and sent their parents to travel abroad for half a year. At least their ears would be quiet for half a year.
At this stage, the boss, Shang Zhi, is so focused on reaching the peak of Tianxin Group’s career that he has no time to fall in love or marry a wife!
And how could the second-in-command Shangren, who was full of sweet words, say it to just one girl, without it being too wasteful? Dad, please stop making trouble!
The third child, Shang Yong, didn't think too much, but it felt good to be surrounded by a bunch of hot beauties in the nightclub. He didn't want to be pulled by the ear by a yellow-faced woman who talked about her all the way home when he was the king of the nightclub.
So, you want them to get married? Don't be stupid, it will never be possible in the short term!
Chapter 1(1)
"Barrel, open the door!"
"If you don't open the door, I'll get the key and open it!"
"Stop hiding, I know you're in there!"
Outside, there was a loud banging on the door, which made Barrier, who was lying on the bed catching up on sleep, unable to sleep peacefully. She rolled out of bed and put on some clothes. With disheveled hair, she stared angrily at the door panel. She heard the tiger aunt outside the door holding the key to open the door. She took the first step and forcefully opened the door.
"What are you arguing about so early in the morning? I wonder if people are still sleeping?" A dissatisfied look was directed at the middle-aged woman who was stunned for a second.
"You... what are you trying to do to me!" The woman came back to her senses, pointed the finger holding the key at Barry, who looked very sleepy, and yelled viciously, "You still have the nerve to sleep! You haven't paid your rent for three months, and you dare to shout louder than me!"
"It doesn't matter if it's louder than you, no!" Who stipulates that if you haven't paid the rent, you have to speak softer than a mosquito? "I have lived here for four years and earned you four years of rent. Now I have no job and owe you a few months of rent. You are like a murderous ghost, knocking on the door with three meals a day. How is that?"
"Anyway, anyway you——"
"When I find a job, I will pay your rent and I won't run away. You don't have to be here all day long!"
"Wait until you find a job? If you don't find a job for a whole year, won't you owe me a year's rent?"
"If your crow's mouth really tells you the truth, then you won't be asking for rent this year." She didn't find a job. She was very happy, wasn't she? "I want to sleep, don't knock on the door againOtherwise, I’ll curse you to not be able to collect the rent for the entire building in the second half of the year. "
"You think I'm afraid of you by saying this? "The landlord, who was quick-sighted, used Zhongguang's body to block the door before she wanted to close the door. "Ruier, I thought that you had lived here for four years, and that's why I didn't let you go for so long. So, don't say I'm unkind. I'll let you stay for four months after four years. You already owe me three months' rent. I'll let you stay until the end of this month. When the time is up and the rent is not paid, you will move out automatically, but you still owe me four months -"
"Got it! You don’t have to read it all the time. "
Pushing open the big meatball stuck in the crack of the door, she closed the door forcefully. All her sleepiness disappeared, and Barrier sat blankly on the edge of the bed.
It's the beginning of the month, and there are still more than twenty days before the end of the month, but...even if she successfully finds a job these days, she won't have money to pay rent at the end of the month.
In fact, it wasn't that she couldn't find a job. After graduating from college, she worked as a graphic designer in an advertising company and did a pretty good job. But she was tired, really tired. It's hard to imagine that she suffered from burnout in just four years.
Maybe it's because her mother passed away last year, which made her realize that life shouldn't just be like this...
Maybe...
In short, her interest in her job in the advertising agency waned and she lost her enthusiasm.
She knew that in today's society with high unemployment, she should cherish a stable job and cherish it, but she didn't know what was wrong with her. She lost her resignation and left in a hurry. Although her colleagues were shocked, they did not forget to work hard to get a seat. Everyone strived to get up and sit in her seat.
Looking through the bank books, she found that her savings were very small, with only a few thousand yuan left. If she saved a little, the money could cover a month's food expenses, but it was not even enough to pay one month's rent.
The mother had breast cancer, and the three sisters had to pay for the medical expenses during her lifetime. She spent all her savings, and the only property of the family was sold. The old house that held the memories of the three sisters growing up together was also sold.
The eldest sister is married and has a child. Her brother-in-law has been laid off by the company and the family is in financial difficulties. She can no longer add to the burden on her eldest sister. The second sister flew to the United States with her American boyfriend and doesn’t know where she will end up...
Barrier smiled bitterly. Even if her second sister was in Taiwan, she couldn't help her. The optimistic second sister always spent as much as she could and never had any so-called spare money.
She had several good friends from whom she could borrow money, but she didn't want her friendship to be interrupted when she borrowed money to pay the rent. It seems that this is the only solution at hand——
Her eyes were fixed on a certain magazine on the bed. The guy on the cover was so handsome that he even eclipsed the stars in the sky. He owed her a small "love fee" hundreds of years ago.
She didn't know if he still remembered, but she would remember it for the rest of her life, not because he owed her money, but... he was her first crush when she was a child.
Staring at the person on the cover, she blushed inexplicably.
In the sixth grade of elementary school, the class teacher hopes that students from well-off families can cultivate a heart of love and care for the society while living a prosperous life. Starting from the first day of the first semester of the sixth grade, he hopes that each of them can donate ten yuan every day and put it into the class's love box. When the semester is not over, the love box will be donated to the social welfare unit.
Her family was well-off and was not on the list of daily donations set by the class teacher, but she "lent" him the ten yuan for breakfast every day to donate to the love box, because the rich young man only had thousand-yuan bills and no ten-yuan coins.
At first, she secretly had a crush on him and told him generously, "No need to pay back the money," but she remembered that he had told her, "I will pay back the money in one lump sum before graduation."
But, have you paid it back? Not really.
Therefore, in order to raise the rent, she had to bite the bullet and ask him for this "old love debt".
She quickly wrote a paragraph on the calendar paper, thoughtfully attached a return envelope, and wrote the name she rented.Post Office Box Address.
Looking at the hateful guy on the cover whose smile made her blush and make her heart beat, she wondered if after so many years, his mouth was still so "tongued" that it made her want to cut off his tongue——
Alas! It's been a long time, she doesn't care whether he turns into a sweet-talking and sentimental guy, or a dumb guy who can't speak a word, as long as he is willing to pay back the money to help out, the two of them "do not owe each other" from now on.
The headline in the weekly magazine read——
The acting president of Tianxin Group holds Shangren's night party, hot girl, hot girl with cleavage
